seoTitle: Optio.News Case Study: Building an Image-Forward RSS News Platform (Flask, Python)
metaDescription: How I turned 94 raw RSS feeds into a fast, image-led news platform — parallel crawling, og:image enrichment, burst-based trend detection, and a clear-glass UI. Live at optio.news.
cardSummary: Optio.News aggregates 94 news sources into an image-forward, editorial reading experience. I built the full stack solo: a parallel crawl pipeline with og:image enrichment (60%→98% image coverage), burst-based trend detection, and an adaptive card UI — live in production on Flask with a 56-test suite.
